All 7 checks from the review request pass. 12/12 pytest cases green against the live preview backend at https://avision-study-dash.preview.emergentagent.com/api/test-prime.

checks.2_clat_start_schema: PASS — POST /attempts/start for CLAT (t_clat_full-mock_2) returns 120-question paper. TITA wrong answers score 0.0 (no negative applied) despite CLAT neg=0.25 — verified additionally against IPMAT SA (neg=1.0) where all 15 TITA wrongs → marks_earned=0.0.

critical_code_review_comments: test_prime.py is 1677 lines — consider splitting the CBT engine (start/patch/submit/analytics + question generators) into a submodule (e.g. test_prime_engine.py) to keep files <700 lines per repo convention.

In _passage_question(), when the caller asks for `correct` index other than 1, the code swaps opts[1] and opts[correct] — but if correct==0 this still leaves index 1 as the original balanced answer. The current logic works because option-content and correct-index are decoupled at scoring time, but the swap comment claims to 'place the correct option at `correct`' which is misleading. Consider clarifying or removing the swap altogether since the correct index is stored explicitly.

start_attempt() persists the full questions[] (with 'correct' + 'explanation') server-side and returns _public_attempt(doc) which strips them via _strip_q — good. But get_attempt() and save_state() both round-trip through _public_attempt so the same stripping happens. Confirmed no leakage in tests.

_translate_stub returns '[हिं] <english>' — this is a stub that satisfies 'non-null string' requirement but is not a real translation. Fine for infra tests, but flag as MOCK for the Vercel manual QA — Hindi users will see the English text with a Hindi prefix marker.
